meta.title: "Declare missing function" codefix offered on arguments
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#50189 (fix(50188): omit QF on function arguments), a44354af7c, 2022-08-05; git tag --contains: first in v4.8-rc / v4.8.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.7.4 (2022-06-17) and typescript@4.8.2 (2022-08-25), both behind typescript-language-server@1.1.2 (the latest wrapper release before 4.8.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. The add-missing-function-declaration fix is older than 4.7 (the report says it is offered in every version tried).
meta.notes: The fix is to stop offering the code fix for an unresolved identifier used as an argument, so a post-fix build that offers no matching action is 'absent' (missing: absent). Applying the pre-fix action declares asdfasdfa as a function and passes it where a number is expected.

settings_note: The issue names no settings (playground defaults); no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project.

repro.steps: Open index.ts: 'f(asdfasdfa)' reports TS2304 (cannot find name 'asdfasdfa'). Reported: the quick fix 'Add missing function declaration asdfasdfa' is offered for the argument; expected: no such code fix (it is meant only for the callee of a call expression). Probe: apply the offered fix; a fresh session on the edited file must neither report the targeted TS2304 nor a new error (declaring the argument as a function passes a function where number is expected). No offered action counts as absent.
